_doc: Fixture manifest for the multi-view skew sets (testset/skewset_*), added 2026-08-18.
These differ from every other testset entry: an entry is a SET of frames of ONE spread
from different viewpoints, not a single capture. Read with docs/plans/multiview-phase1-prereg.md
(the pre-registered claims) and the docs/RESULTS.md row of the same date (how the sets were
chosen, and the four corrections made on the way).
anchor    = the FACE-ON frame, chosen by MEASURED legibility (most dictionary-valid tokens),
NOT by capture order -- see RESULTS 'Correction 1'. This is the frame production
would feed Stage 03, and the frame band GT is keyed on.
candidate = the oblique frame that recovers the most gutter text the anchor misses.
orientation_pin = degrees CW to apply to the RAW buffer. Pinned per set by majority because
the shipped resolver disagrees with itself across frames of one spread on two
sets (resolver_disagreed); see testset/gt/orientation.json.
page_crop = [x0,y0,x1,y1] as fractions of the UPRIGHT frame, HAND-READ off a 5% grid.
Hand-specified because three automatic page-crop routes were measured and
rejected on this batch; this is also how the original three Phase 1 pages were
prepared. target_page says which half the crop takes, so which edge is the gutter.
headroom_gutter = GT-FREE dictionary proxy, per band half-width about the spine. It RANKS
sets; it does not score arms. gain = valid tokens the candidate reads that the
anchor misses (the quantity STEP 2's ceiling measures); loss = the reverse.
headroom_wholepage = the same proxy over the WHOLE page, kept only to show why it is the
WRONG question (it is dominated by the far side; see RESULTS 'Correction 2').
orb = the Phase 0 diversity screen, kept with inlier counts attached. NOT an entry gate:
it returns 3-13 inliers on the strong-curl sets, which is finding 0b replicating.
OWED: the gutter and far-side band GT is NOT yet keyed, so no arm has been scored on these
pages. Key it in the band definition temp/mv_phase1/gt_far.json already uses (text-column
coordinates, not page fractions), then make ONE scoring run per the pre-registration.

skewset_en_01.notes: Largest gutter headroom in the batch (+42). A clean complementary-halves pair by eye, the Phase 0 picture on a new book: 135113 reads the RIGHT page well and compresses the LEFT page's inner column; 135111 reads that inner column and foreshortens the right page. Dense continuous prose both sides, so the band will key thickly.

skewset_it_01.notes: The required Italian, and the batch's only strong-curl Italian. The set that exposed Correction 1: its frame 0 (134759) is the OBLIQUE view, not the anchor. 40 gutter tokens available against an anchor reading 66 = a 61% relative ceiling on the band that matters.

skewset_de_01.notes: The required German, and the WEAKEST fixture in the set -- stated up front. This book is a figure-heavy guide: the page is banners, photos and a route map with a single block of continuous prose, so the anchor holds only 13 valid tokens in the gutter band against 66-79 on the other three. Its +9 net and 18:9 gain/loss ratio are the cleanest asymmetry in the batch, but on a base that small the German arm of Claim A will be noisy, and a German result should not be quoted with the same confidence as the English or Italian one. The right fix is a German book with continuous text, not more frames of this one.

skewset_orient_01.notes: Orientation fixture, not a measurement set. 134655 is resolved 180deg on an OSD call of conf 2.58 while 134657/134658 resolve 0deg at conf 16.6/10.4 -- min_conf 2.0 accepted noise, and the layer-5 landscape prior cannot see a 180deg error because a rotated spread is still landscape. Also unfittable as a multi-view set: 134655 is a page-TURN shot, so it photographs different content (0-1 word correspondences).

skewset_orient_02.notes: The sharper orientation fixture: a full-bleed Croda Rossa panorama with almost no text, so OSD has nothing to work with (conf 0.24 / 1.59 / 3.09) and the set splits -- two frames below min_conf kept raw at 0deg, one accepted at 180deg. Doubles as the 'do not wreck a mostly-photo page' regression guard the multiview plan's invariants ask for (only 1-4 valid tokens per frame; never a validation set).
